headlines.title: Women Lead Parade of Victories to Help Democrats Win House
headlines.abstract: Women ran in historic numbers, breaking rules and upending conventional political wisdom.

headlines.title: Democrats take control of House but Republicans tighten grip on Senate
What will House Democrats fight the Trump administration on first?
Democrats’ policy agenda likely to include cooperation with Trump
Trump Vows ‘Warlike Posture’ if Democrats Investigate Him
headlines.abstract: The president said he hoped to cut bipartisan deals but vowed to retaliate if the new Democratic-controlled House examines his finances and political dealings.
